design_rule: Arabic is a first-class source and identity language. Never require translation into French/Latin before evidence can be stored or searched.
match_key_normalization_only: remove Arabic harakat/diacritics for match-key only
normalize Alef variants أ إ آ ٱ to ا for match-key only
normalize Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII digits for match-key only
forbidden_normalization: Do not equate ى and ي unless corroborated by entity evidence
Do not equate ة and ه
Do not use automatic transliteration as proof of identity
Do not force one Latin spelling when several official forms exist

entity_model.ambiguity_policy: If more than one canonical entity remains plausible, status must remain AMBIGUOUS. No best-guess resolution.
